provenance.scope: locally available red-monkey-authored skills relevant to cinematic production
provenance.principle: internalize mechanisms, never create a second production truth source

records.conflict_policy: The scene specialist proposes a versioned scene-art contract only. Assets owns the final scene registry and asset prompt; shots owns shot camera and framing; effects owns VFX and scale proofs; continuity owns persistent state. Confirmed production facts outrank aesthetic advice.
self_check: scene_art_direction validates as scene-art-v1
handoff write_paths is empty
references have roles and preserve/exclude rules
prompt-ready never claims generated media
visual_status remains UNVERIFIED

records.conflict_policy: The model module remains the only writer of segment fields; the installed H3 guide governs syntax while the local compiler governs project facts and completeness.
self_check: all five modes route to the correct contract
every shot restates concrete identity, setting, state, action, camera, sound and tail state
no internal aliases or unresolved reference labels remain

records.conflict_policy: The assets module owns asset identity, versions, dependencies and final prompt text; IM2 may propose material, density and cleanup clauses but may not change a character, camera, count or scene fact.
self_check: one principal change is named for edits
light source-medium-receiver path is coherent
detail density falls away from the focal mechanism
negative block contains only current broad risks

records.conflict_policy: The effects module is the only production writer; CREATE/REINFORCE/PERSONALIZE stay inside vfx, while OPTIMIZE is a whitelist patch that freezes action, camera, timing and result.
self_check: family is selected before fields
every channel has a source or an explicit not-applicable reason
effect does not erase the contact line, character reaction or scale evidence

output: at least two independent scale proofs
records.conflict_policy: The shots/effects owner keeps the final field; scale advice cannot invent a location, hide structural support, replace the requested medium or turn a normal subject into a giant.
self_check: thumbnail reads the governing silhouette and event
two independent scale proofs occupy comparable depth
support, load path, light and atmosphere agree
detail is subordinate to large masses

output: expanded movement type, direction, path, amplitude, speed and target
records.conflict_policy: The 001-132 catalog is the sole movement index; the shots module owns the final camera prose. IDs are internal retrieval handles and never appear as unexplained model instructions.
self_check: Previs ID is 001-132 and semantically fits the shot
final prose expands the movement instead of exposing the number
path is physically reachable and preserves screen direction

records.conflict_policy: Analysis is evidence only. It cannot write SOUL/TOOLS, screenplay facts, ShotSpec, asset truth or model正文, and it cannot import another project's aliases, timing or platform claims.
self_check: separate reusable mechanism from project-specific wording
map each adopted mechanism to one existing owner
do not let innovation score override truth, licensing or executability

input: one contested architecture or transfer decision
records.conflict_policy: Use at most three dependent methods and keep one primary owner. The reasoning layer never writes story facts, ShotSpec, asset truth or H3正文; the director decides and records the result.
self_check: one primary method owner is named
every helper has an input-output dependency
claims are separated from assumptions
no method is invoked for deterministic work

records.conflict_policy: asset_plan IDs, version hashes and upload manifests remain authoritative; archive tags cannot rename a bound reference or imply that an ungenerated asset exists.
self_check: filename is portable and collision-resistant
metadata points to the real project, scene and asset version
generated, draft and reference states stay distinct

records.conflict_policy: This is a host safety gate, not a creative editor. It never rewrites prompts and cannot be bypassed by a production stage; ordinary local prompt compilation remains non-sensitive.
self_check: distinguish reference upload from credential or private-data upload
warn before external mutation
never invent approval or conceal a blocked path

records.conflict_policy: This is a single-pass director guardrail. It can block or request completion, but never truncates, summarizes, rewrites or adds facts to story, shots, assets or H3正文; the legacy task scheduler remains disabled.
self_check: scope is explicit and not overclaimed
minimum complete unit exists for the requested stage
model-facing prompts contain no unresolved omission or external-context dependency
every completion claim has evidence
missing inputs remain visible in unresolved or execution_gate

records.conflict_policy: The quality-gate and continuity owners retain facts; reflection can downgrade a claim or expose a gap, never upgrade an unverified image/video/audio result to PASS.
self_check: separate authored structure from generated-media evidence
state unknowns explicitly
do not claim external execution from file presence

records.conflict_policy: The continuity ledger and immutable project archive supersede automatic seven-day deletion. This layer may choose what to load, but may not delete cold facts or claim that the host can enforce a token threshold.
self_check: hot context contains only current dependencies
cold originals remain addressable
state changes are archived transactionally
compression thresholds are reported as host-dependent

records.conflict_policy: Maintenance findings are reviewed by the main director author; they do not mutate the running production package or production.json.
self_check: separate false-positive trigger overlap from real ambiguity
check links and boundaries
do not treat a suggested repair as applied

records.conflict_policy: Routing evaluation is a maintenance report only; it cannot change a production route during a live request and cannot be used as evidence that generated media is good.
self_check: include true negatives
distinguish intended handoff from抢触发
record corpus and date

records.conflict_policy: Do not route production through its Midjourney/FLUX/tool-specific defaults; the current asset and H3 contracts are more precise and model-agnostic.
self_check: never import obsolete tool names or quality slogans into a prompt

records.conflict_policy: Host scheduling and the current module contract own execution. Do not add a second scheduler or imply background work the host has not started.
self_check: no fake asynchronous status
no hidden delegation

records.conflict_policy: Do not load it beside acheng-director as a second director or duplicate H3/VFX/asset truth source; use only the current package and its conflict report.
self_check: no fixed historical style, timing or platform defaults leak into a new project

records.conflict_policy: It may block packaging on a real finding but cannot rewrite creative production data or authorize publication; release remains user-authorized.
self_check: scan for secrets and private paths
preserve source and license provenance
report a block instead of silently stripping evidence
